svg.title: AIcoach, Faithful Merge: Upload on the phone
svg.text: The coach asks; the checklist is its message.

g.text: mp4 or mov · max 15 s · from Photos or Files

text.tspan: Stored on the AIcoach server until you
delete it. Only you can see it.

svg.text: Steps stream in; key frames pin themselves.

g.text: Got it. A clean clip. Watching now.
Ask when the result is ready

svg.text: Verdict, 7%, two frames. The rest is one tap down.

text.tspan: early extension, and I’m sure of it.
It may feel like you stay down, but
at impact your hips have moved

g.text: How do I know the drill is working?
Answers are based only on this analysis.
